bic_trace_step.reason: In the new function `rxgk_verify_response()`, after acquiring a valid `rxgk_context` via `rxgk_generate_transport_key()` (line: `gk = rxgk_generate_transport_key(conn, token->rxgk, sp->hdr.cksum, GFP_NOFS);`), the code fails to call `rxgk_put(gk)` on both error and success paths. Specifically, after `rxgk_decrypt_skb()` failure (line: `ret = rxgk_decrypt_skb(krb5, gk->resp_enc, skb, &auth_offset, &auth_len, &ec);`) and `rxgk_verify_authenticator()` failure (line: `ret = rxgk_verify_authenticator(conn, krb5, skb, auth_offset, auth_len);`), the function jumps to `out` (line: `goto out;`). The `out` label only contains `key_put(key);` and does not release the `gk` context, causing a memory leak. The success path also reaches `out` without releasing `gk`.
